images.prompt:
Create one cinematic 16:9 horizontal first-frame key image for a later live-action commercial comedy video. This is the exact BEFORE-action frame, not a collage or a completed action. Preserve realistic anatomy, natural contact with surfaces, and a clean readable hierarchy. No subtitles, readable interface text, dates, venue information, logos or watermark-like graphics; specified text will be composited afterward.  Visible cast only: The human technician is a compact, strong Black woman in her mid-50s with a broad round face, very short copper-colored natural curls and focused eyes, no glasses. Dusty-violet insulated technician jumpsuit with white piping, flat gray work shoes, no helmet or institutional logos. | The original nonhuman alien stands about 2.2 meters tall, with a broad round cylindrical torso and a small flat oval head merging into the body without a neck. A rigid pearl-colored faceplate has one horizontal amber eye visor and no human nose or mouth. Each hand has exactly three thick fingers. Matte ivory-and-charcoal integral exploration suit, wide horizontal waist band and simple broad boots; no resemblance to a known franchise character. Scene: Low wide cinematic night shot with one huge STATIC oval spacecraft behind two figures, door closed, lights steady. The compact Black woman in a dusty-violet jumpsuit stands LEFT, supporting a rigid BLACK DOCUMENT FOLIO-CASE approximately38x30x14cm on her LEFT forearm. Its substantial depth and tightly packed red-tabbed draft edges are clearly visible through the side gap from the start. Its closed front retaining flap carries one clean result sheet; her RIGHT hand rests on the upper edge before presenting it. The ivory-and-charcoal alien stands RIGHT with a long closed document cylinder in both hands, angled downward away from the human. Dry clear ground below both; no paper has fallen. Physical page placement lock: the clean success sheet is fixed to the OUTSIDE face of the front retaining flap, so it is visible while the flap is closed. The same sheet stays attached to that outside face when the flap opens downward; revision records are inside the case, not the success sheet.
Use case: ads-marketing. This is an original science-fiction commercial scene with expensive theatrical night lighting, cool steel-blue environment and faint warm amber spacecraft light, physical practical textures. Frame is 16:9, 1536x864. Establish identities and props clearly for following shots. No existing franchise designs. No glowing weapons.
images.artist_notes: Establishing frame. Two original characters, deep folio/red tabs and outside success sheet, closed cylinder, no fallen paper.
